svg.text: A comic panel: thick black brush ink, flat primaries, Ben-Day
dots only in the shadows, action lines on moving rides,
sound effects, a speech bubble, white page gutters.

g.text: Ink: 3-4 px black on every edge, 7 px on rails.
Fill: flat primaries; top faces 35% lighter.
Shadow = Ben-Day dots, never a darker tint.
Motion: action lines + sound effects on rides.
Riders sit in the coaster and bumper cars.
